subject.title: [deep-review] Tracking: 26 issues from senior-engineer multi-axis architecture review

question: Should this tracker remain the canonical backlog for remaining deep-review rows, or should maintainers split the still-live security/auth/release rows into new focused issues now?
rationale: The tracker intentionally bundles partially fixed code defects, active release-security direction, and architecture debt, so automation cannot choose the durable tracking structure without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep tracker canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open and update rows one at a time as maintainers verify or land focused fixes.

options.title: Split remaining security rows
options.body: Create focused follow-up issues for each live security/auth row and close this tracker only after every row has a canonical destination.

options.title: Close after packaging handoff
options.body: Move only the updater/signing row to the packaging issue and accept losing the tracker as the consolidated source of truth for the other rows.

recommendation.title: Keep tracker canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and update rows one at a time as maintainers verify or land focused fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already made the consolidation decision in the issue discussion and has recent history across the central files.
